title: SeeGULL Multilingual: a Dataset of Geo-Culturally Situated Stereotypes
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating social stereotypes and geo-cultural biases in multilingual LLMs across various nationalities and regions. While it addresses 'fairness' and 'safety' in model evaluations, it does not have a dedicated component for benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, or specific theological/ethical systems.
